objective: Test whether ORACLE generates persistent out-of-sample risk-adjusted excess return versus QQQ without optimizing to force a win.
principles: No parameter change may be justified solely by improving historical alpha.
All model changes are versioned and dated before subsequent performance is observed.
Discovery, company capture, entry timing and sizing are separate gates.
Every historical test must use point-in-time information and a survivorship-aware universe where available.
Transaction costs, FX and delistings must be included when the data permits.
Failed hypotheses and all tested variants must be logged, not silently discarded.
